title: Japanese Tamagoyaki Omelette with Tofu
description: A Japanese-inspired omelette made with tamagoyaki and firm tofu, perfect for a quick and easy breakfast or snack.
instructions: 1. Cut the firm tofu into small cubes.
2. Slice the tamagoyaki roll into thin strips.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and rice vinegar.
4. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
5. Add the sesame oil and swirl to coat the pan.
6. Add the tofu cubes and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
7. Add the tamagoyaki strips and cook for another minute.
8. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the tofu and tamagoyaki.
9. Sprinkle with scallions and season with salt and pepper to taste.
